svg.title: Adaptive bitrate: the rendition chosen for each 6-second segment as bandwidth changes
svg.desc: Measured bandwidth per segment: 6, 8, 9, 9, 4, 2, 2, 3, 6, 9, 9, 9 Mbps. The player starts at 480p, then picks the highest rendition at or below 80 percent of the last measured bandwidth: 480p, 720p, 1080p, 1080p, 1080p, 720p, 480p, 480p, 480p, 720p, 1080p, 1080p.
svg.text: rule: highest rung ≤ 80% of last measured bandwidth
segment number (6 s each, 72 s in all)
starts at 480p for a fast first frame, climbs, drops 2 rungs
in the dip, climbs back: a switch is the next file from another row
